dedupe_keys.name: operateurs sur le reseau ferre national

description: Opérateurs sur le réseau ferré national is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Liste des opérateurs fret et voyageurs facturés par SNCF Réseau pour l’horaire de service 2020. Cette liste inclut: les entreprises ferroviaires, les candidats autorisés, les gestionnaires d’infrastructure ou d’Autorité organisatrice des transports. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Réseau. Its keywords are SNCF RESEAU, clients, usage du réseau, opérateur ferroviaire, Fret, Voyageur. The portal shows 2022-03-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/cgu/A1#A1). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
